Title: General Availability: Azure HDInsight in Japan West and US Central

Body.Content: Azure HDInsight is now generally available in the Japan West and US Central regions, meaning you can host HDInsight in those regions with the same service-level agreement coverage available in other regions around the world. Japan West and US Central are the latest HDInsight regions, joining US North Central, US South Central, and Asia Pacific East. The HDInsight Pricing Details page has been updated with geography-specific pricing for Japan West.
